name: Trouble in Darkshore?
summary: In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker seeks help for his missing crew. His introductory appeal sends travelers across the sea to Auberdine, where the dwarven expedition met Darkshore's wild, shadowy coast.

sections.title: A Silent Expedition
sections.body: Darnassus, the grand night elven capital, is home to dwarven researchers from Ironforge studying Kalimdor's ancient mysteries. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sent an excavation party across the water to Darkshore to unearth artifacts of antiquity. Weeks have passed without a message or progress report, and Greywhisker fears his field crew has met dangers they could not survive alone.

sections.title: Threats Unburied
sections.body: Greywhisker laments that many in the Alliance dismiss dwarven archaeology as an eccentric hobby. Findings in Khaz Modan have convinced his colleagues that an ancient, terrifying force threatens Azeroth from Lordaeron to Kalimdor. The work in Darkshore's ruins is more than scholarship: it seeks to understand historic cataclysms and the deep-seated menaces buried beneath ancient soil.

sections.title: Contact at Auberdine
sections.body: Sail across the channel from Teldrassil to Auberdine, the coastal haven, where Archaeologist Hollee waits in town. Relieved that Greywhisker sent help, Hollee says the expedition is in dire straits. The crew ran into trouble farther down the coast while searching for ancient relics.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Trouble in Darkshore?
aliases: where to get trouble in darkshore
faq.answer: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker offers this introductory appeal in Darnassus, seeking travelers to check on his missing crew.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this quest?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Travel from Darnassus across the sea to Auberdine in Darkshore, where Archaeologist Hollee is waiting.

faq.q: Why are dwarven archaeologists in Darnassus and Darkshore?
faq.answer: After discoveries in Khaz Modan, dwarven researchers began investigating ancient sites across Kalimdor for clues about ancient forces threatening Azeroth.

faq.q: What happens after finding Archaeologist Hollee?
faq.answer: Speaking with Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine leads into 'The Absent Minded Prospector', which asks you to search Darkshore's wilderness for Prospector Remtravel.

faq.q: Why hasn't the excavation crew reported back?
faq.answer: The crew met unexpected dangers and setbacks in the field in Darkshore. Its members became separated and cut off from communication with Darnassus.

faq.q: What looming threat is Greywhisker referring to?
faq.answer: Greywhisker points to discoveries in Khaz Modan that suggest an ancient, pervasive danger lies deep within Azeroth's historic ruins.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see the Explorer's League tradition of studying titan lore and ancient history carried to new continents.
As a night elf, you may regard dwarven excavators arriving in your ancestral coastal ruins with cautious amusement or quiet concern.
As an Alliance traveler, you see cooperation growing between Ironforge and Darnassus, linking Teldrassil with mainland Kalimdor.
